row:
*General health education on posture, spine, joints, and daily movement habits.*

This channel explains how the spine and joints work, what commonly aggravates them, and what the evidence generally says. It is educational. It does not offer diagnosis, treatment recommendations, or consultations.

*WHAT YOU WILL LEARN*
• How the spine, discs, nerves, and joints function
• Factors that contribute to neck, back, and joint problems
• Posture, ergonomics, sleep positions, and daily habits
• How conservative, non-surgical approaches are generally used

*PRESENTED BY*
Yama Zafer, D.C.
Registered chiropractic practitioner, Traditional and Complementary Medicine Division, Ministry of Health Malaysia
Practicing in Kuala Lumpur
https://www.mychiro.com.my/yama-zafer-dc/

*IMPORTANT*
All content is general health education only. It is not a diagnosis, not a treatment recommendation, and not a substitute for assessment by a qualified healthcare professional.
